saw_lines: Hospitality staff hide job hunts from their current bosses, so they will not apply to a listing that exposes them.
So the anonymous promise has to show up before any sign-up, or the most careful candidates never start browsing.
Your site already shows four candidate quotes, so the next move is to open your 7 Google ads with one of them, since a candidate’s own words cut through hiring noise.
ads_1: Google text ads leading with anonymous browsing and culture-fit matching, not CVs
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
